text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: streaming.endpoint.v1 /streams p95 elevated (1.2s) p99 spike (6.1s). Several SSE/WebSocket clients reporting stalled chunks and disconnects in eu-west-1. playbook=streaming-tail. Impact: degraded tail latency, a few client reconnect loops.
sre-oncall: I'm taking this. marking SEV-2, will run quick triage. joining call in 2m.
kevin-eng: seeing a lot of `write timeout` and `client reset` in stream-proxy logs around 18:29-18:35 UTC. proxy outbound queue depth climbed.
jamie-support: Customer A (enterprise) escalated — they see partial responses then reconnects. want ETA for workaround.
ingrid-plat: metrics: proxy pool p95 write latency doubled, upstream model nodes look healthy (cpu/gpu ok). suspect backpressure from slow consumers + proxy buffering.
sre-oncall: first mitigations: 1) enable soft-eject for slow clients on stream-proxy in eu-west-1, 2) reduce proxy write_buffer to 64KB, 3) bump keepalive timeout to 90s. Applying now.
ops-bot: @sre-oncall running `kubectl -n infra patch deployment/stream-proxy --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"mitigation":"soft-eject-3549"}}}}}'`
kevin-eng: FYI logs show repeated `EPIPE` after large chunks, and some clients not reading fast enough -> proxy FIFO fills and stalls new writes. we'll also flip a routing rule to route low-priority customers to a fallback variant with smaller chunk sizes.
alex-prod: Please confirm customer-facing messaging. If we soft-eject slow consumers, they may see reconnects — need a short note.
jamie-support: Drafting message: "We're investigating degraded streaming performance in eu-west-1; temporary reconnects possible while we mitigate. ETA 15-30m." sending to Customer A after you confirm.
sre-oncall: Confirmed. jamie send. Also enabling increased proxy concurrency (scale +2 replicas) and clearing proxy write buffers. `kubectl scale deploy/stream-proxy --replicas=6 -n infra`
ingrid-plat: scaled replicas to 6, rolling restart in progress. watching p95/p99.
kevin-eng: After scale + soft-eject, p95 dropped from 1.2s -> 420ms, p99 from 6.1s -> 1.8s. Still seeing intermittent tail gaps.
sre-oncall: Good improvement. Next: enable aggressive prefix KV cache on model-serving side for long-running streams to reduce per-token tail pressure. Rolling out as patch.
ops-bot: Incident page created: https://status.internal/incident/3549991111 (auto-updates).
alex-prod: Customer A acknowledged message, appreciates ETA. No other broad customer complaints so far.
kevin-eng: Suggest we add a short-term proxy config: `stream_proxy.config.max_write_backlog=32` and a 30s client drain policy. I'll open PR for config and can hotpatch if needed.
sre-oncall: Proceed with hotpatch. I'll keep monitoring for 30m, if p99 stays <2s we'll de-escalate. Please add notes to postmortem channel once stable.
jamie-support: Noted — sent customer update.
ingrid-plat: p99 now ~1.2s after patches; no new `write timeout` errors in last 3m. marking mitigations effective.
sre-oncall: Starting timeline capture and will hand to postmortem. Leaving watch for 30m. If anyone sees new regressions ping me directly. :thumbsup:
